facts.form: pullover, V-neck, long sleeves with tubular cuffs, tubular knit bottom

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6110 covers knitted pullovers and similar articles; chapter 61 notes do not exclude
GRI 6: 6110.20 of cotton; 6110.20.20 other (not flax 36%+); men's or boys' other (non-sweater) line, following fine jersey-knit pullover rulings

rejected_alternatives.reason: men's sweaters line; applies only if knit is coarse (low stitch count) sweater-type, not shown for fine jersey
T-shirts, singlets; a V-neck long sleeve pullover with cuffs and waistband is a pullover of 6110

missing_facts: Stitch count per 2 cm (determines sweater vs other statistical line)
classification.rationale: Knitted cotton pullover is heading 6110. Fine jersey knit pullovers were classified in men's 'other' cotton line in I83145 (in force; its older suffix 65 no longer exists, current equivalent is .69). Suffix depends on the stitch-count assumption.
